baseline_models.focus_anchor: The completed relative-clause verb kafaru at word 3 is followed by the imperfect predicate yukadhdhibuna at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: A settled covering or rejection of truth supplies the stance; the imperfect attribution of falsehood supplies its recurring outward operation. The verse diagnoses an active counter-verdict sustained by prior concealment, not a passing lack of certainty.

activation_trace.role: The covering or rejection of truth grounds the settled concealed stance named by kafaru.
Declaring a thing or its bearer false makes yukadhdhibuna an active counter-verdict rather than mere uncertainty.

changed_reading.before: They do not believe and say that the message is false.
changed_reading.after: A settled act of covering truth is maintained through repeated acts of publicly assigning falsehood to what confronts them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence kafaru-yukadhdhibuna joins failure to acknowledge with a verb whose branch inventory includes a charge proving false when it is not carried through.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two roots can describe a failure of enactment as well as a false proposition: something received as truth or favor is covered over, then made to fail by not being carried through into acknowledgment and response.

activation_trace.role: Covering a favor contributes an unacknowledged receipt and makes ingratitude the first failure in the mechanism.
A charge that proves false by not being completed turns denial into failed performance, not speech alone.

changed_reading.before: Their takdhib is only a verbal claim about truth value.
changed_reading.after: Their denial also makes reception fail in practice: what reaches them is not carried through into acknowledgment or responsive action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacent focus roots permit a material sequence from covering at word 3 to an appearance that lies by its condition at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Kafaru lays an overlay across what is present; yukadhdhibuna patterns that overlay into a persuasive but deceptive surface. This is a focus-only image of denial as visibility management rather than simple absence of sight.

activation_trace.role: Concrete covering supplies the overlay that hides what remains underneath.
The deceptively patterned cloth supplies a visible surface whose condition misreports what it covers.

changed_reading.before: They conceal or reject an already available truth.
changed_reading.after: They also manufacture a misleading surface over the concealed truth, making denial a positive production of appearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah begins with opening, casting out, and becoming empty, while the focus roots cover and issue a counter-verdict. The deniers' activity therefore runs against a world whose dominant motion is disclosure: they keep laying verbal cover while the cosmic containers cease to hold their contents.

activation_trace.role: Concrete covering supplies the human anti-disclosure operation.
Declaring the disclosed claim false supplies the recurring verbal attempt to restore the cover.
Splitting and opening make the sky the first large-scale image of a cover that no longer stays closed.
Casting until the contents land supplies the outward transfer by which the earth discloses what was inside.
Bare emptiness completes the disclosure mechanism by leaving the former container without its hidden load.

structural_cues: The paired cosmic if-clauses in 84:1-5 move from closed containers to opened or emptied ones before the focus verse names covering and counter-verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, ejection, emptying, covering, and falsehood-attribution; I supply the directional claim that human denial attempts to oppose the surah's disclosure current. A live alternative is that the cosmic events only stage judgment and do not characterize denial's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The deniers reject a message within an otherwise neutral setting.
changed_reading.after: Their repeated counter-verdict is anti-disclosure labor performed inside a cosmos that is already opening and surrendering what it held.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sky and earth listen and accept what is binding; the humans addressed later neither settle into trusting assent nor lower themselves when the recitation reaches them. Bal then identifies yukadhdhibuna as the active counter-posture: reception is converted into resistance at the levels of judgment, heart, and body.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood supplies the active judgment that reverses receptive hearing.
Listening with acceptance supplies the receptive operation against which denial is contrasted.
Binding necessity makes cosmic acceptance a fitting response to an obligation, not passive acoustics.
The heart settling in security and trust supplies the inward response that remains absent.
Reading and recitation supply the concrete arrival of what can be heard and accepted.
Lowering in submission supplies the bodily completion of receptivity that the verse explicitly negates.

structural_cues: The repeated wa-adhinat li-rabbiha wa-huqqat frames cosmic response, while 84:20-22 moves from no faith to no prostration to bal plus habitual denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accepted hearing, bindingness, inward trust, recitation, lowering, and active falsehood-attribution; I infer one cross-level response system in which denial blocks completion. A live alternative is that these are parallel contrasts without a single causal chain.

changed_reading.before: Yukadhdhibuna reports a mistaken opinion about the recitation.
changed_reading.after: Yukadhdhibuna is the maintained counter-posture that prevents heard truth from settling inwardly and completing itself in bodily submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humanity is already laboring toward encounter and emphatically bearing condition after condition. Against that motion, the focus branch of a charge failing to be carried through makes denial read like an attempted interruption: the deniers pronounce the itinerary untrue while continuing to travel it.

activation_trace.role: Rejection of truth supplies the settled stance taken against the itinerary.
A charge proving false through failed completion supplies the attempted non-fulfillment projected onto the announced journey.
Strenuous striving supplies continuous human motion rather than a static doctrinal scene.
Two things arriving face to face supplies the encounter toward which the labor moves.
Bearing or undertaking an affair makes each condition something the addressee must enter and carry.
Condition after condition supplies the unavoidable serial structure of the journey.

structural_cues: The universal singular address in 84:6 and the emphatic plural transition in 84:19 bracket every audience member inside movement toward encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies labor, encounter, undertaken conditions, serial transition, and a branch of failed completion; I infer that denial tries to make the announced course fail while the denier remains carried through it. The alternative is simply that they deny the destination, without an interruption mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They deny a future event from outside it.
changed_reading.after: They issue a counter-verdict from inside the very journey they call false, attempting to arrest a course that their own passage continues to enact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory permits kafara as covering liability until it is as if not done. Set beside a binding book, calculation, and intended works, takdhib becomes a pseudo-expiation: declaring the record false is an attempted symbolic erasure of what the accounting system continues to preserve.

activation_trace.role: Covering liability until wrongdoing is effaced supplies the model of attempted self-expiation.
Declaring a report false supplies the means by which the denier tries to invalidate the record.
A written fixation that imposes judgment or decree supplies the record that denial cannot actually erase.
Counting and accounting supply the operation that retains and evaluates what the false verdict would dismiss.
Intended action supplies the durable object of judgment and reward, keeping the mechanism tied to deeds rather than claims alone.

structural_cues: The two distributions of the book lead to accounting or ruin, and the closing exception again keys outcome to intended works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expiatory covering, falsehood-attribution, a binding record, accounting, and works; I supply the motive and arrow that denial acts as self-authorized erasure. A live alternative is ordinary rejection of judgment with no imagined acquittal procedure.

changed_reading.before: They deny that the record or reckoning is true.
changed_reading.after: Their denial functions like an unauthorized attempt to void the ledger and cover liability, even while book, count, and deed remain operative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The doomed figure's prior joy occurs within a circle of belonging and accompanies his expectation that he will not return. The focus imperfect can therefore name a socially and affectively renewed practice: familiar delight keeps the covering plausible, while takdhib protects an expectation whose outcome will fail.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the enclosure that keeps the contrary return outside ordinary attention.
An expected supply failing to last gives takdhib a temporal image of confidence that its outcome does not sustain.
The group of nearness and belonging supplies the social enclosure in which the expectation is normalized.
Hidden joy and ease supply the affective reward that makes the enclosing reading attractive.
An affair whose outcome is not trustworthy supplies the unstable expectation protected by denial.
Return and reversal supply the specific future that the social-affective enclosure excludes.

structural_cues: The same family and joy vocabulary appears in the saved return of 84:9 and the deluded pre-return life of 84:13, but with opposite temporal placement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies belonging, joy, an unreliable expectation, return, covering, and failed duration; I infer that social pleasure helps reproduce the denial. A live alternative is that family joy is only biographical evidence of heedlessness, not a causal support system.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an isolated intellectual judgment by individuals.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be a recurring social-affective enclosure in which belonging and present joy continually make non-return feel sustainable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night gathers what is dispersed, the Qur'an arrives as a gathered and recited whole, and God knows what the deniers gather into the heart. The focus verse sits at the interface: covering supplies a lid, while takdhib repackages what was received into an inward counter-assembly rather than leaving it simply unheard.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the lid over the inwardly accumulated material.
Falsehood-attribution supplies the reclassification that turns received material into a counter-claim.
Gathering dispersed things supplies the surah's first explicit assembly operation in this sequence.
Gathering and joining let the recited Qur'an function as an assembled whole presented to the hearers.
Gathering meaning into the heart supplies the inward container whose contents remain known to God.

structural_cues: The focus verse is bracketed by recitation in 84:21 and divine knowledge of what they inwardly gather in 84:23.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three gathering images, a cover, and falsehood-attribution; I infer that denial reorganizes received meaning into an inward counter-assembly. A live alternative is that yu'una gathers deeds or hostility rather than meanings, so this model must not claim secret assent.

changed_reading.before: They deny because the recitation remains external or never coheres for them.
changed_reading.after: The recitation reaches them as an assembled whole, but they actively reclassify and contain it within a counter-assembly whose contents are not hidden from God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deniers reverse the truth value of revelation by declaring it false; the answering command then places painful punishment inside a verb whose branch image is news that normally opens the face with joy. The sequence forms a paired speech-act reversal: counter-announcement is answered by an announcement with inverted affect.

activation_trace.role: Rejection of truth supplies the stance from which the first reversal is spoken.
Declaring truth false supplies the reversal of veridical force.
Joy-opening news supplies the normally positive announcement frame that is deliberately retained.
Pain and punishment supply the negative payload that reverses the announcement's expected affect.

structural_cues: Only the divine knowledge statement in 84:23 separates their repeated counter-verdict from the command to announce punishment in 84:24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a truth-value reversal and a positive announcement frame carrying pain; I infer a measured speech-act correspondence between them. A live alternative is ordinary irony in 84:24 without a specific relation to yukadhdhibuna.

changed_reading.before: Verse 22 states denial, and verse 24 independently threatens punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their repeated reversal of truth is answered by a formally mirrored announcement whose affective value is itself reversed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cultivator who covers seed is far from the ordinary religious sense of kafaru. It remains anchored in the focus root's explicit seed-covering branch and in the earth casting out and becoming empty. Render it only as a material analogy: denial may defer or bury disclosure, not literally sow truth and not guarantee the denier's renewal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Kafaru at focus word 3 can activate the branch image of a cultivator covering seed, while yukadhdhibuna at word 4 still names the counter-verdict placed over what was buried.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed supplies the odd but explicit material anchor for concealment as burial rather than destruction.
Declaring false supplies the verbal layer placed over the buried material.
Casting contents outward supplies the later exposure that burial cannot permanently prevent.
The emptied and bared container supplies the endpoint at which concealed contents are no longer retained.

changed_reading.before: Covering truth removes it from effective presence.
changed_reading.after: Covering can look like burial: it delays visibility but places what is denied inside a disclosure system that will eventually cast out its contents.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the wild animal's run-stop-look-back image is not the normal sense of Form II denial. It remains anchored in the focus root's branch and is unusually activated by the book behind the back and emphatic passage through successive states. Downstream prose should label it a kinetic analogy for recurrent hesitation, never a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperfect yukadhdhibuna at focus word 4 can carry a recurring run-stop-look-back image rather than a single static verdict.

activation_trace.role: The wild creature running, stopping, and looking behind supplies the recurrent arrest pattern.
Putting something behind visible backs supplies the backward orientation that sharpens the focus branch image.
Undertaking and bearing an affair supplies forward movement through what cannot be avoided.
State after state supplies the successive intervals at which denial can recur as a stop-and-look-back reflex.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a fixed proposition held while events happen elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be pictured as recurrent arrested motion: at each transition the traveler stops, looks backward, and contests the course while still being carried onward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The failing milk image is a remote pastoral branch and cannot replace the ordinary sense of yukadhdhibuna. It remains traceable because the closing reward is explicitly defined by non-cutting, creating a sharp duration contrast. Render this only as a temporal echo: the deniers' counter-expectation fails to last, while the promised reward does not run out.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yukadhdhibuna at focus word 4 activates a branch in which an expected supply proves false by disappearing, while kafaru at word 3 supplies the failure to acknowledge favor.

activation_trace.role: Covering a favor supplies the unacknowledged good against which durable reward can stand.
A supply that fails expectation by not lasting supplies the fragile duration of the deniers' counter-claim.
Cutting and diminishing until extension ends supplies the negated endpoint that defines the reward as uncut.

changed_reading.before: Their denial is false only in propositional content.
changed_reading.after: Their counter-expectation is also temporally false: it cannot sustain itself, in contrast to the reward explicitly protected from ending.

strongest_changes: The opening and emptying cosmos turns denial into anti-disclosure activity rather than neutral nonbelief.
Accepted hearing, inward trust, and bodily lowering recast yukadhdhibuna as a maintained counter-posture that blocks a complete response.
Book and account activate denial as pseudo-expiation, an attempt to void liability by declaring the fixed record false.
The recitation and inward gathering sequence makes denial a counter-assembly of received meaning, without requiring a claim of secret assent.
summary.what_was_special: The focus pair generated several coexisting mechanisms: concealment plus counter-verdict, failed enactment, deceptive overlay, resistance to disclosure, social-affective reinforcement, and temporal arrest. The packet's material branches made denial an active production and management of surfaces, records, containers, and interrupted motion rather than a single private opinion.
remaining_uncertainties: The direction from cosmic disclosure to a human anti-disclosure strategy is abductive; the cosmic scenes may only establish judgment's setting.
Yu'una may denote accumulated deeds or hostility rather than gathered meanings, so the counter-assembly model cannot imply concealed belief.
The failed-charge, seed-covering, wild-animal, and failing-duration branches are useful mechanism images but remain distant from direct lexical rendering of the focus forms.
The social setting may sustain denial, or it may merely depict the ease that preceded the false expectation of no return.
